<var>
$DPS$ = (Damage * Burst Count) / (Burst Cooldown + (Firerate * Burst Count))
$DPS2$ = Damage / Firerate
$CE$ = Total Cost / DPS
$TP$ = $FNC-TOTAL-COST$
$TE$ = $FNC-TOTAL-EXP$
$COST$ = 300; 325; 700; 1250; 1950; 3500; 7000
$1B$ = 4
$2B$ = 8
$3B$ = 12
$4B$ = 16
$BDPS$ = * Operator Stats.Burst Count) / (Operator Stats.Burst Cooldown + (Operator Stats.Firerate * Operator Stats.Burst Count))
$1BP$ = Operator Stats.Coordination Damage Boost * $1B$
$1BD$ = {{#expr:floor(Operator Stats.Damage * (1 + $1BP$ * 0.01))}}
$1BDPS1$ = ($1BD$ $BDPS$
$1BDPS2$ = $1BD$ / Operator Stats.Firerate
$2BP$ = Operator Stats.Coordination Damage Boost * $2B$
$2BD$ = {{#expr:floor(Operator Stats.Damage * (1 + $2BP$ * 0.01))}}
$2BDPS1$ = ($2BD$ $BDPS$
$2BDPS2$ = $2BD$ / Operator Stats.Firerate
$3BP$ = Operator Stats.Coordination Damage Boost * $3B$
$3BD$ = {{#expr:floor(Operator Stats.Damage * (1 + $3BP$ * 0.01))}}
$3BDPS1$ = ($3BD$ $BDPS$
$3BDPS2$ = $3BD$ / Operator Stats.Firerate
$4BP$ = Operator Stats.Coordination Damage Boost * $4B$
$4BD$ = {{#expr:floor(Operator Stats.Damage * (1 + $4BP$ * 0.01))}}
$4BDPS1$ = ($4BD$ $BDPS$
$4BDPS2$ = $4BD$ / Operator Stats.Firerate
$FSE-DETECTION$ = 1; ; 2
$EXP$ = {{#expr:floor(75 * 1.075^(Level - 1) * (Level > 0))}}
$FSE-UPGRADE$ = Tactical Gear; Convergent Forces; Cyber-Enforcer; Threat Detection Sentinel; Synchronized Vision; 1000-THR E.M.
$FSE-UPGRADEICON$ = 70928079601135; 114583008682832; 104986848983674; 76868080888172; 83041543058774; 119843960971904
$FSE-META$ = Evolved; File:DefaultOperator0.png
$R$ = $FNC-RECURSION$
$DREF$ = <ref name=dps>Calculated as (Damage × Burst Count) ÷ (Cooldown + (Firerate × Burst Count)).</ref>
</var>
